description.value: Trees Organic Coffee & Cheesecake is a Vancouver-area cafe chain operating since 1996, famous for its award-winning homemade cheesecakes made from a signature New York-style recipe and freshly roasted small-batch organic coffee. This Surrey location is one of 13-14 retail outlets across the Lower Mainland, each offering a full cafe menu including sandwiches, baked goods, and a variety of teas. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a full sit-down cafe experience with online ordering and in-store pickup available.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 13m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 17m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 18m; rack (3 spaces) at 24m; stands (20 spaces) at 38m; stands (12 spaces) at 76m; stands (6 spaces) at 90m. Total: 50 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Trees Organic Coffee is an active, multi-location cafe chain operating since 1996, with a Surrey location explicitly listed among their 13 locations. The OSM phone (+1-604-684-5060) matches the corporate number shown on the website catering page. Takeout and online pickup ordering are prominently featured on the website; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the address (10299 University Drive, V3T 0N3) is in Surrey, BC — V3T postal codes are Surrey, not North Vancouver.
OSM addr:unit field contains 'V3T 0N3', which appears to be the postal code rather than a unit number — likely an OSM tagging error.
The phone number (+1-604-684-5060) is the corporate/main line; the Surrey-specific manager email (surreymanager@treescoffee.com) suggests a location-specific contact may exist but is not confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe with a confirmed Surrey location and a live website — straightforward inclusion.
